text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 13, 2025) for 1 Runnymede Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 13, 2025) for 1 Runnymede Road, Folder Number 25 208332 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to October 30, 2026.
